## 1. Executive Summary & Strategic Architecture

This 30-year retirement security plan establishes a self-directed, multi-layered financial defense system that bridges cash-flow volatility, inflation risks, rising medical overheads, and future long-term care needs.

3. **Pillar 3: [MASKED] (商业长期护理保险 / 养老社区 / 居家养老服务) – Covers chronic disability, nursing care, and physical assistance in later life without depleting accumulated savings.

### Scenario B: Economic Recession & Ultra-Low / Negative Interest Rate Era

This utilizes accrued policy cash value as a single premium to stop future out-of-pocket premium payments while keeping the insurance policy active at a reduced sum assured [5].
